scenes.basis: 23:1 "The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate" - Pilate's seat at the feast, unnamed in Luke
23:7 "he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days"
23:13 "Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people"
23:33 "When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there"; the tomb of 23:53 is nearby
